title: St. Charles Borromeo, Bishop
subtitle: Memorial · Phil 2:12-18; Ps 27; Lk 14:25-33
text: St. Charles Borromeo (1538-1584), Archbishop of Milan, put the reforms of the Council of Trent to work, founding seminaries and renewing catechesis and clergy. When plague struck Milan in 1576 he stayed, spent his own goods on the sick, and walked barefoot in penitential procession. He lived today's Gospel: carry your cross and follow Christ.
imageAlt: St. Charles Borromeo in a red cardinal's mozzetta and lace rochet, with a halo, presses his hand to his chest and gazes tenderly at a crucifix, with two cherubs below and an archway opening onto blue sky behind him.
